'''Eleanor Bresa''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Bresa Modifications''' in the '''Desy''' system of the [[Colonia]] region. She specialises in suit durability, ammunition, and melee performance alongside weapon magazine and reload modifications.<ref name="inara-eleanor">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/38/ Eleanor Bresa — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-eleanor">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Eleanor_Bresa Eleanor Bresa], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

Frontier introduced Eleanor with the four Colonia Odyssey Engineers and identifies them as providers of suit and personal-equipment modifications for commanders working on low-atmosphere worlds.<ref name="frontier-colonia">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/galnet/the-view-from-colonia The View from Colonia], Frontier Developments, 29 October 2021. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

Eleanor's workshop is at '''Bresa Modifications''', a surface Engineer base on '''Desy 7 a''' in the '''Desy''' system. The body is approximately 3,660 light-seconds from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-bresa">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/427595/ Bresa Modifications — Station], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

The workshop is in the Colonia region, roughly 22,000 light-years from Sol. No system permit is required.

== Discovery and access ==

=== Discovery ===

Eleanor is common knowledge and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-eleanor" />

=== Workshop unlock ===

Visit '''5 settlements in the Colonia system'''.<ref name="inara-eleanor" />

The qualifying visits are to Odyssey settlements in the system named Colonia, not merely to any five settlements elsewhere in the wider Colonia region.

Station services may not appear immediately after the unlock completes. If necessary, return to the main menu and re-enter the game.<ref name="inara-eleanor" />

== Services ==

Eleanor installs four suit modifications and three handheld-weapon modifications.<ref name="inara-eleanor" />

=== Suit modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Added Melee Damage
| Increases damage dealt by fists and weapon strikes.
|-
| Damage Resistance
| Improves protection against several weapon-damage types.
|-
| Extra Ammo Capacity
| Increases the ammunition carried for each weapon.
|-
| Faster Shield Regen
| Speeds personal-shield regeneration.
|}

=== Weapon modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Magazine Size
| Increases a weapon's magazine capacity.
|-
| Reload Speed
| Shortens the weapon's active reload time.
|-
| Stowed Reloading
| Automatically reloads the weapon while it is stowed.
|}

Suit and handheld-weapon modifications are permanent once installed. The equipment must have an unused modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits are paid at the workshop. See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for equipment grades, modification slots, material handling, and the installation process.

== Reputation and referrals ==

Odyssey Engineers do not use the Grade 1–5 workshop-reputation system used by ship Engineers. Once Eleanor is unlocked, her available modifications can be installed immediately when the equipment and material requirements are met.

Providing Eleanor with '''10 Digital Designs''' Data completes her direct referral requirement toward [[Yi Shen]].<ref name="inara-eleanor" /> Yi Shen becomes available only after the separate referral requirements from [[Baltanos]], Eleanor Bresa, and [[Rosa Dayette]] have all been completed.
